name: Color Profile Metadata
description: Analyzes ICC color profile data, color space declarations, bit depth, and rendering intent metadata to detect AI generation patterns.
mechanism: Examines ICC color profile type (sRGB vs Adobe RGB/ProPhoto), checks bit depth for RAW indicators, and validates color space/profile consistency.
parameters:
Camera profiles: Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB, Display P3
AI-typical: sRGB IEC61966-2.1
Bit depths: 8-bit (standard), 12/14/16-bit (professional)
accuracy: Medium - 70-80%. Strong when advanced color profiles are present.
